root.description: The starting directory for listing changes.

created.description:
The files which appear in the file system but were not present in the `lastSeen` map. Note that if `lastSeen` is
empty, all files will be in this category.

updated.description:
The files which appear in the file system and are present in the `lastSeen` parameter, but with a different
modification time.

deleted.description: The files which **do not** appear in the file system but are present in the `lastSeen` parameter.

seenMap.description:
A map of all files found and their modification times. This can be used by the caller to update their `lastSeen`
map from which the changes were determined.

filesChecked.description:
The number of files (not including directories) checked. This does **not** include hidden files or files for which
the filter lambda returned false.

title: Contains the file changes detected by FileSystem#listChanges.
name: FileSystem.Changes
